model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability for the Mistralv0.2-Base model fine-tuned on various medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—listed in that order, serving as the categories for comparison. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability”, displays a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick marks placed at 1-unit intervals. For each specialty, there is a grouping of six bars, each representing a different fine-tuning dataset, color-coded as blue, orange, yellow, brown, red, and grey, corresponding to the legend labels. Within each specialty grouping, the bars have similar heights; for instance, in the ‘Cardio’ category, the bars range from approximately -22.3 to -22.7. The bars are not sorted by height within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
